items.title: Serialize DONE main merge/cleanup with a global lock
items.context: Add a global mkdir-style lock under .koala/runtime for the DONE main-merge critical section. The lock must prevent two story_advance --phase=DONE calls from concurrently mutating main. If the lock is held, fail before writing phase=DONE with a clear retry hint. Cover preflight through merge/worktree cleanup/branch delete, without touching unrelated story worktrees.
items.userSees: When another DONE merge is active, koala story_advance --phase=DONE prints that the DONE main merge lock is held and the story remains pre-DONE; retry after the other merge completes.

happy.desc: Hold .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock and run story_advance DONE for a TEST story -> command fails before phase=DONE; story remains TEST; output includes retry hint
Normal uncontended DONE still succeeds and removes lock after merge/worktree/branch cleanup

edge.desc: Stale done-main-merge lock older than stale threshold is reclaimed and DONE can proceed

adversarial.desc: If lock is acquired only inside applyDoneMergeEffects after writeStory, contention test must fail because story becomes DONE; smoke catches this regression

items.title: Detect and report partial-DONE stories
items.context: Add a pure detector for phase=DONE stories whose story branch or worktree remains and whose branch is not fully merged/cleaned. Integrate it into doctor or a recovery-facing status path so users see the storyId, branch, worktree path, merge-tree status, and safe next action.
items.userSees: koala doctor reports partial-DONE stories with storyId, branch, worktree path, whether main contains the branch, merge-tree status, and the exact done_recover command to run.

happy.desc: Create a synthetic phase=DONE story with story branch not merged and worktree still present -> koala doctor --format=json reports it under partialDone with storyId/branch/worktree/mergeTree status
koala doctor text output for the same state includes done_recover --storyId=<id>

edge.desc: DONE story whose branch is already merged but worktree directory remains is reported as terminal worktree cleanup issue, not partial-DONE

adversarial.desc: Non-DONE active story with branch/worktree residue is not reported as partial-DONE

items.title: Provide a safe partial-DONE recovery command or doctor repair path
items.context: Implement a mechanical recovery path that checks main clean except unrelated paths, verifies merge-base/merge-tree safety, merges the story branch, removes the worktree, deletes the branch, and refuses if any condition is unsafe. This should recover the exact B-9027 failure mode without requiring handwritten git commands.

items.title: Expose operator-visible proof for concurrent DONE and partial-DONE recovery
items.context: Turn the regression work into an operator-visible capability: a maintainer can run the documented Koala command/smoke path and see that concurrent DONE contention fails before phase=DONE is written, and that a simulated partial-DONE story is detected with a recovery command that completes merge/worktree/branch cleanup without handwritten git rescue. The underlying tests belong in verificationIntent/evidence, but the checklist item is the visible proof that operators no longer have to manually reconstruct the recovery sequence.
items.userSees: Operator can run the documented verification/recovery path and see clear output: concurrent DONE lock contention is refused before phase=DONE, partial-DONE is reported with storyId/branch/worktree/main status, and recovery completes merge + worktree removal + branch deletion.
